mapper.sql: c.category_seq, c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_seq, c.level_no, c.sort_order, c.use_yn, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, p1.category_id AS parent_category_id, p1.category_name AS parent_category_name, CONCAT_WS(' > ', p2.category_name, p1.category_name, c.category_name) AS path_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category ch WHERE ch.parent_seq = c.category_seq) AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product pr WHERE pr.category_seq = c.category_seq) AS product_count
FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_category p1 ON p1.category_seq = c.parent_seq LEFT JOIN tb_category p2 ON p2.category_seq = p1.parent_seq

where.if: AND ( LOWER(c.category_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(c.category_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_category SET category_name = #{categoryName}, parent_seq = #{parentSeq}, level_no = #{levelNo}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_seq = #{categorySeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category WHERE parent_seq = #{categorySeq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product WHERE category_seq = #{categorySeq}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(category_seq, parent_seq, depth) AS ( SELECT category_seq, parent_seq, 1 FROM tb_category WHERE category_seq = #{categorySeq} UNION ALL SELECT c.category_seq, c.parent_seq, a.depth + 1 FROM tb_category c JOIN ancestors a ON c.category_seq = a.parent_seq WHERE a.depth < 10 ) SELECT category_seq FROM ancestors
